tool.name: Segment Anything Model 2

param.name: points_per_side
param.label: The number of points to be sampled along one side of the image. The total number of points is points_per_side**2.
param.help: The number of points to be sampled along one side of the image. The total number of points is points_per_side**2.

param.name: pred_iou_thresh
param.label: A fitering threshold in [0,1], using the model's predicted mask quality.
param.help: A fitering threshold in [0,1], using the model's predicted mask quality.

param.name: stability_score_thresh
param.label: A filtering threshold in [0,1], using the stability of the mask under changes to the cutoff used to binarize the model's mask predictions.
param.help: A filtering threshold in [0,1], using the stability of the mask under changes to the cutoff used to binarize the model's mask predictions.

param.name: stability_score_offset
param.label: The amount to shift the cutoff when calculated the stability score.
param.help: The amount to shift the cutoff when calculated the stability score.

tool.help: SAM 2: Segment Anything in Images and Videos.
